task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a 178cm, 82kg athlete aiming for muscle gain with no dietary restrictions
criteria: Daily caloric total must be between 3,100 and 3,450 kcal
Protein intake must be between 164 and 182 grams
Carbohydrate intake must be between 413 and 457 grams
Fat intake must be between 103 and 114 grams
Meal plan must include at least 4 distinct meals or eating occasions
Each meal must specify exact foods with portion sizes (grams or standard units)
Meal timing should be provided for each eating occasion
All meals must be compatible with no dietary restrictions (omnivorous options acceptable)

task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a 165cm, 58kg athlete aiming for fat loss with a vegetarian dietary restriction
criteria: Daily caloric total must be between 1,740 and 1,932 kcal
Protein intake must be between 116 and 128 grams
Carbohydrate intake must be between 174 and 192 grams
Fat intake must be between 58 and 64 grams
Meal plan must include at least 4 distinct meals or eating occasions
Each meal must specify exact foods with portion sizes (grams or standard units)
Meal timing should be provided for each eating occasion
All meals must be vegetarian with no meat, poultry, or fish products
Protein sources must come from eggs, dairy, legumes, nuts, seeds, or plant-based alternatives

task: Create a 1-day meal plan for a 188cm, 71kg athlete aiming for endurance performance with a vegan dietary restriction
criteria: Daily caloric total must be between 2,665 and 2,958 kcal
Protein intake must be between 133 and 147 grams
Carbohydrate intake must be between 399 and 442 grams
Fat intake must be between 89 and 98 grams
Meal plan must include at least 4 distinct meals or eating occasions
Each meal must specify exact foods with portion sizes (grams or standard units)
Meal timing should be provided for each eating occasion, with emphasis on pre/during/post-workout nutrition
All meals must be vegan with no animal products including meat, poultry, fish, eggs, dairy, or honey
Protein sources must come exclusively from legumes, nuts, seeds, soy products, grains, or plant-based alternatives
